entities.name: Nemanjić Serbian Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Nemanjić Serbian Empire, a political institution in Kosovo during Medieval Kosovo and the Serbian Kingdom (1170–1389). Grew from Slavic Settlement and Byzantine Era and Bulgarian Empire. Led to the emergence of Nemanjić Serbia and Kosovo as Heartland and Battle of Kosovo (1389).
